title: feat: add jake, awesome and deedy resume templates from the latex classics
body:
## Summary

Phase 8 (résumé-template half) of the pipeline programme: three templates ported from the canonical LaTeX classics into Typst, taking the set 13 → 16.

- **jake** (ATS tier) — the tech-standard minimal, routed through the parametric `single_column.typ` with a centred 24pt name
- **awesome** (design tier) — thin accent header band (Awesome-CV lineage), bespoke `.typ`, full ATS-mode degradation (band + section markers drop)
- **deedy** (design tier) — modern single-column (Deedy lineage), bespoke `.typ`, accent surname + wider section rhythm via a new `section_above_extra` registry knob

Plus: golden/validator matrix coverage for all 16 (validator matrices now derive from `canonical_template_ids()` so a template can't skip coverage), regenerated preview assets + showcase banner, `TemplateId` now imported from the wire contract everywhere (drift becomes a `tsc` error), a third honest ATS-hint variant for decorative-only templates (en+de), and `docs/EXPORT_TEMPLATES.md` synced (twelve → sixteen, including the previously-missing cologne-navy row).

## Internal review (pre-PR gates)

3-pass `pr-reviewer` ensemble (opus + 2× sonnet) — 9 findings fixed across two domain authors, highlights:
- jake's `name_centered` was a render no-op (`align(center)` inside an auto-width block) — caught by measuring glyph coordinates in the committed previews; fixed with render-measured centring tests + a left-aligned control, other 14 templates verified byte-identical by SVG hash
- Awesome's DOCX band was run-level crimson shading with hardcoded white text (invisible wherever `w:shd` isn't honoured) and ignored `ats_mode` — now paragraph-level pale-tint shading with dark ink per the Banded-letter precedent, gated on ATS mode like the PDF
- a suspected band overflow was confirmed *worse* than predicted: long contact lines rendered off the sheet entirely; the header now wraps inside the printable width with a title-aware band height, pinned by render measurements
- the ATS toggle falsely told awesome/deedy users it "removes the photo" — a third hint key now covers decorative-only design templates in both call sites

Steward close included (EXPORT_TEMPLATES.md + knowledge-base sync, lessons log, graphify).

## Gates

`cargo fmt` · `clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked -D warnings` · `cargo test --all-features` (3652 lib incl. golden + validator matrices, 18 architecture) · `pnpm typecheck` · `pnpm lint:strict` · `pnpm gen:ipc:check` · desktop vitest (3112) + shared (261) + translations — all green.

* **Improvements**

  * Updated English and German translations for decorative ATS guidance.
* **Documentation**
  * Updated template catalog, ATS behavior, and preview documentation.
